title: Castlevania: Nocturne
description: In the thick of the French Revolution, members of the so-called lower classes are rising up to fight inequality. Meanwhile, Richter Belmont senses a far grimmer and greater danger. He’s picked up his family’s long-held tradition of vampire hunting, a vocation that goes back almost as long as a vampiric life span (in other words, forever) but he’s never seen anything quite like what he’s witnessing now.

episodes_data.title: Castlevania: Nocturne 1x1
episodes_data.description: An attack on their camp spurs vampire hunter Richter and young mage Maria to seek the help of the Abbot of Machecoul. Strangers bring news from abroad.

episodes_data.title: Castlevania: Nocturne 1x2
episodes_data.description: As the threat of a Vampire Messiah looms, Tera's past holds dark omens for the future. Annette, Edouard, Richter and Maria head for the château.

episodes_data.title: Castlevania: Nocturne 1x3
episodes_data.description: In shock after a loss, Annette shares the story of her escape from slavery and her journey from Saint-Domingue. Chaos erupts at a public gathering.

episodes_data.title: Castlevania: Nocturne 1x4
episodes_data.description: Olrox voices doubts to Mizrak about the Abbot's alliances. Desperate to help a friend, Annette leads a risky mission over Richter's objections.

episodes_data.title: Castlevania: Nocturne 1x5
episodes_data.description: Drolta makes a persuasive pitch to Olrox, and Annette encounters an old enemy. Revelations shed new light on Maria and Richter's family histories.

episodes_data.title: Castlevania: Nocturne 1x6
episodes_data.description: While Richter learns about the Belmont legacy, Annette searches for the wisdom of her own ancestors. Edouard attempts to get through to a comrade.

episodes_data.title: Castlevania: Nocturne 1x7
episodes_data.description: Emboldened by her victories, the Vampire Messiah steps into the spotlight. Richter flexes new abilities. Olrox makes a surprising proposal.

episodes_data.title: Castlevania: Nocturne 1x8
episodes_data.description: With the Abbot poised to make an unthinkable sacrifice and Erzsebet's plans already in motion, Richter and his allies hurl themselves into battle.
